t: A fast RISC-V microcontroller chip with precise built-in analog sensing.
steps: Buy the HPM5100EVK evaluation board from HQChip, a Chinese electronics store.
Install the HPM SDK from HPMicro's GitHub page along with its RISC-V GCC toolchain.
Install CMake and the HPMicro OpenOCD tool that the SDK lists.
Plug the board into a computer with a USB-C cable to reach its onboard debugger.
Build the hello world sample for the HPM5100EVK and flash it.
Open a serial terminal to see the board print its greeting.
Try an ADC sample next to read a voltage on one of the analog pins.
